name: Mk 45 5"/62 Naval Gun Shell
description: 127 mm shell from the Mk 45 mount on the bow of an Arleigh Burke. A dumb ballistic round — the fire-control computer solves the lead + loft, the gun lays on it, gravity does the rest. Used against ships and shore targets inside ~20 km. High muzzle velocity (~800 m/s) and a real HE warhead; no guidance, no countermeasure beats it but it has to be aimed well. Visual stand-in: small SDB-class body.
